The Builder keeps this owned snapshot unchanged and serializes a separate explicitly wire-canonical copy using only the existing codec projections below. This copy preserves semantic register/block identities, all calls and normal/language edges, and original Source paths and anchors; catch expansion retains both canonical operations. Missing snapshot, missing independent directory join, incomplete projection or partial matching fails. No manufactured empty plan, absent-plan fallback, raw-plan compatibility form or added Source authority is permitted.

semanticPlanCorrespondence.record: Each Common ABI carries exactly one required sourcePlan object with carriers and ordered blocks. semanticPlanCorrespondence.wireCanonicalProjection: Only the existing Common opcode codec projections are permitted. The actual cold env_parent decoder independently reconstructs its layout by joining the input Env carrier to the admitted Env parent directory and the output Env carrier, without reading the witness as authority. All other operation names, properties, operands, results, successors, views and anchors remain exact. These bounded copies and joins use the existing prepaid scan, copy and directory rates on the same live Common balance; no refill, broad property omission or operation skipping is allowed.
